title: The CRIT Strategic Leverage Protocol
rules: Never use AI as an overpriced Google search; treat it as an adversarial thinking partner deployed on the single 20% problem that moves 80% of enterprise value.
Provide Context without filter: detail the company stage, runway, exact financial stakes, and raw operational roadblocks.
Assign a hyper-specialized Role: command the model to act as a world-class domain expert with cross-disciplinary edge (e.g., cross-border distressed debt restructuring banker), not a generic title.
Mandate the Interview: invert the prompt dynamics by requiring the model to ask 3 to 5 targeted diagnostic questions one at a time before generating solutions.
Dictate a ruthless Task: require non-trivial, non-obvious execution steps instead of surface-level bulleted summaries.
